title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning and audit logging for customer-managed keys
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 customer-managed key use; emit structured audit logs for cross-region KMS operations; include migration guide and feature flag for rollout.
description:
Context: Customers using private KMS keys in customer-managed KMS instances requested strict region residency controls and explicit audit trails when keys are used outside pinned regions. RBAC v2 introduced policy-level KMS residency attributes but enforcement and audit were not yet implemented for customer-managed keys.

Summary: This PR implements enforcement of KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies and adds structured audit logging whenever a customer-managed KMS key is accessed from a non-pinned region. The work includes: (1) policy evaluator checks in the RBAC engine to validate key region vs. resource residency constraints, (2) enforcement hooks in the serving runtime to block or mask requests depending on policy, (3) audit log enrichment (kms.region, kms.key_resource, requester_region) emitted to the central audit pipeline, and (4) a migration guide + feature flag to opt-in rollout.

Why: Prevent silent cross-region key usage and give security teams clear, queryable audit trails. This reduces compliance risk for customers with data residency requirements and enables audits for regulated customers.

What changed (high level): - Policy evaluator: added region_pin attribute parsing and evaluation for customer_kms principals. - Enforcement layer: added preflight KMS residency checks that return 403 with structured error on violation. - Audit logging: added structured fields and a dedicated audit event type kms_region_violation. - Migrations & docs: added a migration script to backfill policies with default region when onboarding, updated docs and migration guide. - Tests: unit and integration tests for evaluator, enforcement, and audit pipeline.

Checklist: - [x] Design review (SEC & SRE) - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests (locally + canary) - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] Feature flag gating for staged rollout - [x] CC: security@redwood for review

Migration notes: New RBAC v2 policies that reference customer-managed KMS keys without an explicit region will be considered non-pinned and will be rejected when the feature flag is ON. We include a migration helper (scripts/migrate/add-default-kms-region.py) to populate a default region from the customer's account metadata. Recommend running the migration in pre-prod, validating audit logs, and enabling the flag in a canary subset of customers.

Rollout plan: Ship behind feature flag (rbac_v2_kms_region_pin). Enable for internal account group first, then 5% of customers, monitor audit events and errors, then full rollout.

Testing notes: Added unit tests for policy parsing, evaluator, and enforcement; integration test mimics cross-region access and verifies audit event emitted to audit-pipeline mock. Verified Canaries for two test customers in us-east-1 and eu-west-1.

Related: ENG-8342, SEC-412, PM-279.
